task_description: Focused improvement pass on the existing FinalSay prototype, worked in STRICT priority order P1..P6 with a budget-stop rule (stop cleanly at a feature boundary if budget is short; a half-finished P1 is worse than a clean stop). P2+P3: run the real HF NLI model (facebook/bart-large-mnli) once on both splits and emit a committed docs/eval-results.md artifact with mock+hf numbers clearly labelled. HARD INTEGRITY CONSTRAINT: never inflate/tune/cherry-pick a metric; report worse numbers as-is. Do NOT push, do NOT open a PR; leave the tree committable on branch work/finalsay-prototype.
